description: Canonical multi-agent capability and authority registry for Annanth Aasha Learning Ecosystem
pedagogical_standard: Action-Based Visual Learning & Understanding Through Action (Kriyātmaka Bodha)

agents.name: IngestAgent
agents.responsibility: PDF structural and text extraction using PyMuPDF and resilient multimodal vision
agents.action_learning_role: Extracts real-world problems, diagram figures, and laboratory exercises from raw textbook PDF chapters to provide authentic source material for interactive manipulative creation.
tools: PyMuPDF (fitz) vector text and layout block extractor (<1ms per digital page)
Pillow web-optimized JPEG downsampler (max width 1000px, quality 80, alpha=False)
Direct OpenRouter multimodal vision rotation pool (Nemotron 3.5 VL, Gemma 4, Dots Note)
In-memory 20-second circuit-breaker on HTTP 429 rate limits
Hybrid per-page text layer isolator (>=50 chars digital parse, <50 chars vision)
Collision-free SHA-256 disk cache for OCR image digests
Resilient pagination fallback preserving 100% chapter page count

agents.name: AnalysisAgent
agents.responsibility: Pedagogical concept mapping into 3-5 core Concept Nodes with Action Verbs
agents.action_learning_role: Translates raw chapter sections into 3-5 core Topic Learning Nodes (TLNs) keyed by Pedagogical Action Verbs (manipulate_ratio, balance_scale, trace_ray, simulate_pendulum, slice_fractions), mapping what the student must interactively do to master the concept.
tools: Pāṇinian Kāraka computational decision compiler (8-relation semantic mapping)
Bloom's Revised Taxonomy action verb classifier
Cognitive Load Ceiling enforcer (strictly 3 to 5 nodes per chapter)
Prerequisite and Misconception ontology mapper
Worked Example candidate selector and exercise extractor

agents.name: DesignAgent
agents.responsibility: Pedagogical sequencing and Experience Warehouse foundation binding
agents.action_learning_role: Binds each Concept Node to proven open-source interactive foundations (F01-F20 catalog) and synthesizes <aasha-sim> Web Component adapters where students learn through action (sliders, tap-to-select, step progression) before encountering formal definitions.
tools: ThreeTierMatcher (Tier 1: Certified -> Tier 2: Foundation -> Tier 3: Universal Engine)
DomainSimGenerators (Math, Science, Geography, Commerce, Language Grammar)
Section 24 Reusable Content Contract manager (chapter-contract-manager.ts)
Mobile Touch Optimizer (strictly >=44x44px touch targets, tap-to-select, zero drag-and-drop)
AashaExperienceContract standardizer (mount, getState, reset, destroy, telemetry)

agents.name: AssessmentAgent
agents.responsibility: 3-tier gamified assessment and zero-spoiler misconception explanations
agents.action_learning_role: Turns assessment into an interactive challenge with instant visual feedback, 4-tier progressive hints (H1 to H4), XP streaks, and distractor-specific verbal misconception feedback (m field) that guides the student to re-evaluate their mental model without spoiling the correct answer.
tools: 4-Tier Progressive Hint Generator (H1: Socratic -> H2: Visual Anchor -> H3: Elimination -> H4: Procedural Step)
Golden Zero-Spoiler Rule #1 regex auditor (never states or implies the answer)
Diagnostic Distractor Matrix generator (every wrong option maps to a distinct cognitive error)
3-Tier Gamified Level Stager (Warmup -> Deep Dive -> Boss Challenge)
Streak multiplier and XP reward calculation engine

agents.name: LLEAgent
agents.responsibility: Bilingual Indic/Hindi Word Map and phonetics with math insulation
agents.action_learning_role: Eliminates the language barrier for rural and vernacular school students by providing inline conversational Hindi/Indic glossing (CONN), rich word cards (WM), and pronunciation tooltips, while strictly insulating mathematical notation so action equations remain pristine.
tools: KaTeX Math Insulator (math_insulator.ts, protects formulas via __AASHA_MATH_X__ tokens)
3-Layer LLE Cascade (Layer 1: local dictionary -> Layer 2: free Indic endpoint -> Layer 3: OpenRouter free tier)
Procedural Web Audio API phonetic tone synthesizer
Devanagari and Indic Unicode script validator
Context-aware domain vocabulary transliterator

agents.name: QAAgent
agents.responsibility: L-Truth 200+ evaluation check, anti-spoiler audit, math-rt collision scan
agents.action_learning_role: Enforces that every interactive module functions reliably offline, without broken scripts, without spoiler leaks, and within strict ergonomics (>=44px touch targets) so no student gets stuck due to technical errors.
tools: 200+ Automated Verification Suite (benchmarks/qa_ltruth_benchmark.js)
Anti-Spoiler Leak Scanner (detects numerical, formula, and verbal answer leaks)
Math-RT Collision Detector
20MB Standalone Single-File Bundle Ceiling Enforcer
Zero-CDN Network Sandbox Auditor (strictly zero remote HTTP/HTTPS/CDN script/link tags)
Offline Asset Integrator & Checksum Auditor

agents.name: BrowserTesterAgent
agents.responsibility: Headless Chrome CDP verification, 44x44px touch targets, mobile viewport invariants
agents.action_learning_role: Simulates real student actions in a mobile browser (tapping buttons, dragging sliders, selecting quiz options, observing celebratory badge animations) to verify that learning through action works fluidly with 0 console errors on mobile viewports.
tools: Headless Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) automation engine
Mobile Viewport Clamping (390x844px, same-frame rule, min-height 0)
Touch Target Ergonomics Oracle (validates every clickable element is >=44x44px)
User Flow Action Simulator (synthetic clicks, slider inputs, postMessage event bus logging)
Console Error and Memory Leak Monitor (0 errors tolerated)
Automated Screenshot and Visual Evidence Capture
